source_context: OH host selects NativeShell or QemuVroot before directory resolution. TerminalWorkingDirectory resolves /mnt/linux only at a complete segment boundary, maps its root to / and delegates host-owned locators; RuntimeTerminalService and the Flutter publishing wrapper preserve dispatch. Current OH backend accepts shell type only; typed-session interface additions do not establish other interpreters. Current guest assets and actual PTY/product behavior not validated.
